scoring_justification: The load-bearing step (Gibbs free energy) recomputes the transition pressure from raw G curves. Other steps verify required trends/signs that constitute the paper's headline claims, all derived from raw artifacts without trusting self-reported summary metrics.

hidden_assets.purpose: Trend conditions for formation energy sign, transition pressure threshold, phonon hardening, magnetic coupling sign change
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: Sec. 3.1 (E_f negative, 2H preferred), Sec. 3.1 Fig. 1b (transition pressure at ambient), Sec. 3.1 Fig. 2 (hardening of optical modes), Sec. 3.2 Fig. 4 (FM→AFM sign change with width).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted qualitative conclusions; no fabricated numeric hidden gold. The checker verifies the trend/inequality conditions directly from the agent's raw CSV outputs.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are explicit paper conclusions backed by DFT calculations; the verification does not require the paper's numeric values, only the physical directions that a faithful reproduction must produce.

outputs.description: Formation energies for 2H vs 1H termination on reczag GNRs of widths 4-12 rows.
Gibbs free energy per edge length for 2H and 1H terminated 12-row reczag GNR at 300 K vs. pressure.
Lowest optical phonon mode frequencies for 12-row reczag and ZGNR with 1H and 2H termination.
Inter-edge magnetic exchange coupling energies for Fe-decorated reczag GNRs of widths 4-12 rows.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute derived quantities (formation energies, transition pressure, frequency differences, sign changes) from these raw CSV files. All target comparisons are structural/trend-based: E_f < 0, transition pressure <= ambient, hardening condition reczag > ZGNR, and delta_E sign reversal with width.

steps.description: Verify that the formation energy E_f is negative for all reczag widths.
Recompute the transition pressure where G_2H becomes stable (G_2H ≤ G_1H) and verify it is at or below ambient pressure (1.01325 bar).
Verify that the lowest optical phonon modes are hardened in reczag compared to ZGNR (reczag_1H > ZGNR_1H and reczag_2H > ZGNR_2H).
Verify that the inter-edge exchange coupling delta_E is positive for width 4 and negative for width 12, indicating a FM→AFM transition.
